! Game text
| Use 1 Force to deploy on opponent's side at any unoccupied site. Moves during your control phase (like a character) at normal use of the Force. When at same location as Tagge or warrior of ability &lt; 3, choose one to be immediately lost. Seeker also lost. || {{Errata hl|Deploys for 1 Force to an unoccupied site}}. {{Errata hl|Deploys and moves like an undercover spy}}. When {{Errata hl|present with}} Tagge {{Errata hl|(or warrior)}} of ability &lt; 3, choose one to be immediately lost {{Errata hl|(treat as an "all cards" situation)}}. Seeker is also lost.
